assumptions: The historical 2004 Compustat vintage is unavailable; current COMP.FUNDA with INDL/C/D/STD product filters is a documented proxy.
The pooled Regression (4) is estimated by OLS with an intercept, conventional OLS standard errors, no weights, and no fixed effects because the paper does not report these details.

Annual accounting amounts, balance-sheet denominators, and EPS are translated to USD with provider-documented GBP cross-rates at exact fiscal-period dates; unresolved currency rates propagate as missing.

The paper does not identify its CRSP source or date convention. The build selects the latest CRSP market-session date on or before prior fiscal-year end and requires a unique linked common-share record with observed PRC and SHROUT on that exact date; it does not fall back to an older close. Daily RETX is compounded across the actual Compustat fiscal-year interval only when every CRSP session date has a mapped row and nonmissing return. EPS values use AJEX_anchor/AJEX_s before division by raw CRSP PRC; Compustat and CRSP cumulative adjustment endpoints are not combined.

The paper does not identify the scaling/pooling convention for 1% trims. The build uses joint-complete-case pooled cutoffs for beginning-of-year-t USD market-equity-scaled earnings, CFO, and total accruals over t−3 through t+3, plus annual fiscal returns t through t+3. It does not impose an extra percentile screen on the EPS/price regressors. Overlapping anchor windows can repeat annual records in the pooled cutoff population. The separate ±10 accounting screen applies to current/future years t through t+3; future three-year compounded return is screened at ±10.

The support model annual winsorization is interpreted as capping each regression variable at its annual mean plus or minus three standard deviations; coefficients use capped inputs and DAP uses raw accruals minus fitted values evaluated on raw predictors.
Tied smoothing correlations receive average ranks; the score is the descending within two-digit-SIC-year rank divided by the group count.

limitations: The paper's 2004 Compustat vintage and exact primary sample screens are not fully reproducible from its text; current local data and documented best-effort date, currency, link, and percentile rules are used.

The paper does not identify its stock return source or exact fiscal-year price date convention, pooled OLS inference correction, or scaling/pooling details for 1% trimming. Exact beginning-session price coverage is checked without an arbitrary age threshold.

Annual returns are treated as unavailable when any CRSP session in the fiscal period lacks a linked daily row or has missing RETX; this full-period reading follows the paper's annual-return construct, but its source does not spell out the completeness rule.
